Final scene = Touka admitting she killed Akira's father + park with Hinami = ch 120 'VE/SS/EL' exactly. 100 and 104-115 deferred/skipped (100, 105-114 come in ep 18).

Open flag #690 (MU 91 vs AniList 181): the reading edition everywhere (Wikipedia, fandom, Viz) uses the standard 1-179 chapter numbering across 16 volumes; AniList's 181 ≈ 179 + omakes (31.5 and 32.1 per Wikipedia's volume listing). Episode-row title nit: our ep 15 row says 'union: Close Game' — the title is 'Cross Game' (クロスゲーム; fandom 'Cross Game: union', animefillerguide 'union: Cross Game').

In-episode scene ORDER inside eps 16-18 is rearranged relative to the numeric chapters_adapted serialization (e.g. ep 16's final scene is Arima's death from the 83-86 fragments even though 94-98 is the furthest mainline; both fandom pages state 'some scenes are rearranged'). Per-scene ordering beyond what the page splits give is not documented anywhere found — chapters_adapted follows the sources' numeric lists.
